tests.name: Menu runs an activated row once, closes the menu, and reports the action

checks.description: User trigger/dismiss/action reports exact reason once; caller-driven open changes never notify.
Root honors four logical sides and three aligns; submenus anchor row inline-end/start with token gap, flip/mirror RTL/clamp to work area and retain family ownership.
After readiness keyboard/accessibility opens focus first focusable row with native-confirmed result, not command invocation alone.
Pointer opens surface with no row highlight; first Down/Up focuses first/last row; input modality determines opening intent on each presentation.
Native Up/Down wrap focusable rows, Home/End hit endpoints; headers/dividers skipped and disabled rows included only if disabledFocusable.
Printable first-character case-insensitive search starts after current row and wraps, ignores modified keys and headers; no-match leaves focus unchanged.
Leaf activation closes whole family and returns live eligible trigger; Escape closes deepest to parent row, root Escape/Tab/Shift+Tab close family to trigger; native confirmations required.
Outside pointer returns trigger unless another control focused; app deactivate/anchor detach close without moving focus; caller close returns only when presentation held focus.
Two submenu levels open; third warns and stays closed without collapsing ancestors or changing root open state.

tests.name: Menu MNU-007 permits two submenu levels but warns and refuses a third

checks.description: Enter/Space/inline-end open submenu to first row, inline-start/Escape close to parent row; RTL reverses inline arrows; keyboard activation does not end family.
Pointer press toggles submenu without moving focus; at most one sibling per level remains open, descendant input does not dismiss ancestors.
Hover-open enabled respects open and close/switch delays, overrides and platform defaults; timers cancel on close/replacement/unmount; disabled hover setting never opens root or submenus.
While menu holds keyboard focus hovered eligible row focuses; pointer/pen/touch semantics and Win32 paired enter/leave preserve pending open until another row replaces it.
Windows/Win32 inherit disabledFocusable true, macOS false, row override wins; disabled rows refuse press/long-press/keyboard/accessibility activation even if focusable.
Actual presence controls trigger/submenu expanded, default Opens a menu hint, menu surface name from explicit surface then trigger/row string; unnamed root warns; closed refs/content absent.
Invoke Windows ExpandCollapse projection instead of inferring it from synthetic press; states track native dismissal.
Narrator/VoiceOver qualifies menu/row names and roles, checked/disabled/expanded state, entry/return focus and closed-tree absence on every renderer.
Nearer fill/subtle thin border/base400 radius/base200 padding, zero row gap, native elevation, caller surface style last; width fits widest row.
Review popup silhouette/shadow, widest-row sizing, RTL/edge flipping/clamping and submenu overlap on all desktop targets.
Modern Callout/FocusZone route macOS Paper/Fabric and Windows Fabric, Win32 adapters route Office; unsupported hosts throw descriptive errors.
Real family navigation, focus confirmation, activation and dismissal qualify independently on all four endpoints before public export.
